basics.name: Christopher Reagle
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and building scalable, resilient backend systems in high-throughput environments. Currently contributing to McDonald’s global ordering platform, driving performance, reliability, and clean code practices. Experienced in distributed systems, Kafka, CI/CD, and cloud-native architectures. Passionate about mentoring, architecting large-scale systems, and leveraging technology to enhance user experience in agile, fast-paced environments.

work.name: McDonald's
work.summary: Engineer on the FryKids squad responsible for backend systems powering McDonald’s global digital ordering platform, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and scalability across high-throughput environments.
highlights: Supported performance testing environments, identifying bottlenecks and implementing optimizations to enhance reliability and scalability.
Designed and implemented modular, reusable testing repositories with standardized mocks and folder structures, improving consistency and reducing test time.
Led architectural planning and migration to a managed Kafka implementation, improving scalability, maintainability, and platform alignment.
Engineered interfaces for restaurant data, abstracting legacy and future business logic to support feature flagging and reduce code duplication.
Championed clean code and test purity, driving adoption of maintainable, isolated unit and integration testing standards.
Mentored junior engineers, fostering ownership, discovery, and adherence to engineering best practices.
Created automation scripts enabling local environment setup in under two minutes, improving developer onboarding and productivity.
Authored comprehensive onboarding documentation, accelerating new hire ramp-up and providing clarity around technical architecture and workflows.

work.name: Loyal Health
work.summary: Engineered and maintained high-throughput chatbot and live chat systems for healthcare organizations, supporting 1,000+ messages per second and peak loads exceeding 77,000 messages per hour.
highlights: Developed a patient-facing chat service using ChatGPT and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for hospital data integration.
Designed a new dialogue management system with a 50+ rule validation engine, reducing onboarding time for new hires by 50%.
Integrated with healthcare APIs (Epic, Cerner, Infermedica) to enable patient data retrieval and symptom-to-diagnosis workflows.
Built and optimized intent prediction models using TensorFlow, BERT, and feedforward neural networks.
Managed distributed microservices on Kubernetes with autoscaling and hot replicas to maintain uptime during load spikes.
Created Kafka consumers for asynchronous health risk assessment processing and implemented worker patterns for async logging and socket cleanup.
Monitored and tuned SQL performance with Azure SQL execution plans, reducing latency across chatbot, report, and dashboard systems.
Automated SLA monitoring using Checkly and Playwright, proactively identifying production issues.
Standardized CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps YAML templates and Helm-based Kubernetes deployments, ensuring consistent releases across environments.

work.name: Sierra Experts
work.summary: Delivered full-stack software solutions and technical expertise across diverse client industries.
highlights: Designed and implemented a custom ERP system, collaborating directly with stakeholders to define and deliver business-critical functionality.
Built an ETL pipeline consolidating data from multiple large-scale databases using distributed merge replication.
Maintained and improved internal Windows Server backup systems, ensuring data reliability and business continuity.
Provided technical support for legacy and modern applications, ensuring optimal performance and stability.

work.name: Flowline
